description.value: Charleson Park Community Garden is a fenced community garden nestled within Charleson Park near False Creek in Vancouver. It is a publicly accessible green space and a pleasant rest point for cyclists riding the nearby False Creek seawall route. The site is fully wheelchair accessible, suggesting a well-maintained and welcoming public facility.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch was blocked by Cloudflare, so I must rely entirely on OSM tags. OSM includes toilets:wheelchair=yes, which is positive evidence that accessible washrooms are present; all other amenity fields lack any OSM or website evidence. The record is clearly a real public park feature in Vancouver with no closure indicators (looks_closed=false), so inclusion is appropriate.
concerns: Website fetch failed (Cloudflare block) — amenities could not be verified from the City of Vancouver site; relying on OSM tags only.
No address or phone number in OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible community garden in a Vancouver park with no indication of closure; useful to touring cyclists as a rest stop near the False Creek seawall.

wow_evidence: Fenced community garden inside Charleson Park; viewable, plots not public; modest even by garden ladder.
blurb: Fenced community garden in Charleson Park near the False Creek seawall.

price.label: Free
price.signal: Park and community garden; parks are free public spaces
